title: Naturality of the single-coordinate comparison in standing coordinates
statement: Fix a finite purity setting \(P\) [def-pur-conventions], a scheme \(T\), and a separated finite-type structure map \(a_T:T\to\operatorname{Spec}k\). Let \(K,L\in D^+(T,A)\) have retained ordinary constructible finite-Tor representatives and specified realization isomorphisms. For every morphism \(v:K\to L\), the single-coordinate comparison [def-pur-affine-space-comparison] satisfies \(\operatorname{lineSource}(v);\Gamma_{\mathrm{line},L}=\Gamma_{\mathrm{line},K};Rq^!(v)\), where \(q:\mathbb A^1_T\to T\) is the recorded affine-line projection. This holds for every pair of retained representatives and every arrow, including zero arrows.

proof.text: Specialize orderedAffineComparison_natural to dimension one. Expand the ordered recursion: its only nonidentity comparison is the single line comparison, precomposed with I_0 and postcomposed with the identity exceptional compositor. The canonical tensor and identity-pullback comparisons form a natural isomorphism firstSourceIso whose components equal the specified I_0 by their HEq uniqueness. The zero exceptional compositor is the component of rightDerivedUpperShriekCongr, hence is invertible and natural. Substitute these two naturality squares into the dimension-one equation and cancel the invertible source and target comparisons. This proves exactly single-line naturality, for arbitrary v and witnesses, without a new hypothesis or an integration-transpose identity.

proof_origin.place: Dimension-one extraction from the recorded ordered-comparison naturality, using the canonical zero-coordinate source and exceptional isomorphisms.

lean.statement:
theorem lineComparison_natural (P : WeilConjectures.PurityFiniteSetting.{u})
    (T : Scheme.{u}) (aT : T ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k))
    [LocallyOfFiniteType aT] [QuasiCompact aT] [IsSeparated aT]
    (K : Plus (Ring P) T) (Ke : Etale.DerivedCategoryModule (Ring P) T)
    (hKe : etaleFiniteTor (Ring P) T Ke)
    (eK : (comparison (Ring P) T).obj Ke ≅ K.obj)
    (L : Plus (Ring P) T) (Le : Etale.DerivedCategoryModule (Ring P) T)
    (hLe : etaleFiniteTor (Ring P) T Le)
    (eL : (comparison (Ring P) T).obj Le ≅ L.obj) (v : K.obj ⟶ L.obj) :
    (lineSource P T).map v ≫ lineComparison P T aT L Le hLe eL =
      lineComparison P T aT K Ke hKe eK ≫
        (rightDerivedUpperShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (Ring P))
          (AffineSpace PUnit.{u + 1} T ↘ T)).map v
